title: Zesty Chilli Vietnamese Tofu Skewers
description: Rich and tender Vietnamese dish featuring chilli flakes and tempering chocolate, perfect for a vegan-friendly meal

ingredients.name: firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into 1 inch cubes

instructions: Preheat the raclette grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, maple syrup, rice vinegar, garlic, and ginger
Add the chilli flakes and tempering chocolate to the bowl and whisk until well combined
Add the tofu cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade
Thread the marinated tofu cubes onto the bamboo skewers
Brush the skewers with sesame oil and season with salt
Place the skewers on the raclette grill and cook for 10 minutes, turning occasionally
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with chopped green onions and sesame seeds
